name: localmax
description: Open benchmarks for local generative AI

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:web
scripts.seed:local: node scripts/seed-local.mjs > /tmp/localmax-seed.sql && npm run --workspace apps/api migrate:local && wrangler d1 execute localmax --local --file /tmp/localmax-seed.sql --config apps/api/wrangler.toml
scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
